name: web-streetwear-drop-page-in-red-black-and-white-with-brutalist-type
title: Streetwear drop site: red half-hero, statement blocks, greyscale product grid, giant DROP_01 band and log-style updates
whatItIs: A very tall page in red, black and white: a hero 'THE UNRULED' half over a red-toned portrait, statement text with a rotated NO RULES sticker, a two-column greyscale product grid with spec labels, a full-width red DROP_01 band with a photo, a jacket feature with a spec table, a row of shirts, a log list with strikethroughs and a huge 'THIS IS NOT FAST FASHION' footer.
whatItMeans: Loud and raw; red blocks and monospace specs feel like an underground drop.
techniques: Use giant heavy caps with red keywords.
Show products in greyscale with monospace labels.
Use a full-width red band as a chapter.
Style updates as a log with strikethroughs.

vocabulary.definition: A full-width block announcing a release.
A small monospace label with product specs.
A list styled like a system log.
A hero split with a red-toned image.
